hook_en: Great are the works of the LORD. 🙏
reflect_en: The psalmist decided to give thanks with all his heart, not alone, but in the assembly, among God's people. Great are the works of the LORD, and they are pondered by all who delight in them. Today, take a moment to ponder one thing God has done for you, and give thanks for it with your whole heart.
q_en: What work of God in your life are you pondering today?
x_en: Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.
tiktok: Ponder what He's done 🙏 Psalm 111:2 — Great are the works of the LORD
yt_title: Great Are the Works of the LORD | Psalm 111:1–3 #Shorts
yt_line: Give thanks with all your heart today.
li_open: Healthy teams take time to notice what's gone well.
li_quote: I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
li_body: The psalmist gave thanks in the assembly, out loud and together. Leaders who pause to ponder answered prayers with their people, and keep caring for the requests still open, build a community that remembers God's faithfulness.
hook_es: Grandes son las obras de Jehová. 🙏
reflect_es: El salmista decidió alabar a Jehová con todo el corazón, y no a solas, sino en la compañía y congregación de los rectos. Este jueves, detente a recordar algo que Dios ha hecho por ti y dale gracias con todo tu corazón, junto con tu familia o tu iglesia.
q_es: ¿Qué obra de Dios en tu vida estás recordando hoy?
x_es: Grandes son las obras de Jehová; buscadas de todos los que las quieren.
key_en: Great are the works of the LORD
key_es: Grandes son las obras de Jehová
